_comment: Machine-readable model registry used by scripts/audit-models.mjs (and summarised in docs/LICENSES.md and docs/MODEL_VETTING.md). A model, voice or Hugging Face repo referenced in src/ or public/ must be listed here with verdict OK. Voice verdicts: OK = reviewed, redistributable; NOT-OK = blocked (reason in 'blockers'); VERIFY = not proven, treat as blocked until reviewed. 'reviewed: auto' rows were classified from the MODEL_CARD text only. Add or change entries only after following docs/MODEL_VETTING.md.

hfRepos.note: Voices are checked per voice id in `voices`.

components.name: rhasspy/piper (archived)
components.reason: LICENSE.md is MIT (Copyright 2022 Michael Hansen); GitHub API: license MIT, archived. Code only; it needs a phonemizer (see espeak-ng).

components.name: OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl (piper-tts 1.3+)
components.reason: COPYING is the GPL v3 text; GitHub API: GPL-3.0. Embeds espeak-ng. Must not be bundled in the MIT PWA (training tool the user runs is fine).

components.name: rhasspy/piper-phonemize
components.license: MIT own code (LICENSE.md), links GPL espeak-ng
components.reason: LICENSE.md is MIT (Copyright 2023 Michael Hansen) but CMakeLists.txt downloads and builds a rhasspy fork of espeak-ng into the library, so any built binary or WASM is a GPL-3.0 combined work. Repo archived; README says espeak-ng is now embedded in piper1-gpl.

components.name: espeak-ng (code, data and WASM builds)
components.reason: README: 'eSpeak NG Text-to-Speech is released under the GPL version 3 or later license.' Decision 8: nothing GPL is added to main before the decision is recorded.

components.name: phonemizer (npm, xenova/phonemizer.js)
components.reason: package.json and LICENSE say Apache-2.0, but dist/phonemizer.js (1.3 MB) embeds the eSpeak NG WASM and its espeak-ng-data; the upstream issue 'Invalid license' (#6) states it must be GPL. Used by kokoro-js.

components.name: kokoro-js (npm)
components.reason: Apache-2.0 itself (registry: license Apache-2.0), but its dependencies are phonemizer ^1.2.1 (embeds GPL espeak-ng) and @huggingface/transformers. Not OK while phonemizer is required.

components.name: onnxruntime-web
components.reason: npm registry: license MIT (1.30.0); microsoft/onnxruntime LICENSE is MIT (Copyright Microsoft Corporation). Self-host the .wasm files.

components.name: @huggingface/transformers (transformers.js)
components.reason: LICENSE is the Apache License 2.0. Loads models from the Hugging Face hub by default; InkQuiet would have to point it at registered, self-approved URLs.

components.name: k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
components.reason: GitHub API: Apache-2.0. Its Piper (vits-piper) path uses an espeak-ng-data folder shipped with the model package (see wasm/tts/CMakeLists.txt comment), so GPL data may come along. Not verified further.

components.name: diffusionstudio/piper-wasm and similar browser ports
components.license: none stated; build script compiles rhasspy/espeak-ng
components.reason: GitHub API reports no license; build/README clone and compile rhasspy/espeak-ng and piper-phonemize into the WASM. Without a licence file nothing can be redistributed, and the espeak-ng part is GPL.

components.name: Kokoro-82M weights (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX)
components.reason: Hugging Face tags and card front matter: license apache-2.0 (both repos); code hexgrad/kokoro is Apache-2.0. Card: trained on permissive or non-copyrighted audio incl. synthetic audio from closed TTS models; lists CC BY audio (Koniwa tnc <1h CC BY 3.0, SIWIS <11h CC BY 4.0). Keep that credit in the licenses screen. Re-check the tag at download time.
components.attribution: Kokoro-82M by hexgrad (Apache-2.0); training data credits: Koniwa tnc (CC BY 3.0), SIWIS (CC BY 4.0).

components.name: Chatterbox (ResembleAI/chatterbox)
components.reason: Hugging Face tag license:mit (sha 5bb1f6ee); resemble-ai/chatterbox repo license MIT. Output is watermarked with Resemble's PerTh watermark (README). Training data is not documented on the card; Voice Helper only, never shipped in the PWA.

components.name: Orpheus TTS 3B (canopylabs/orpheus-3b-0.1-ft)
components.license: apache-2.0 tag on a Llama 3.2 base
components.reason: HF API: license apache-2.0 but base_model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, so the Llama 3.2 Community License also applies (Decision 8 excludes it). The model card is gated and could not be read; the github repo canopyai/Orpheus-TTS is Apache-2.0.

components.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (cmusphinx/cmudict)
components.reason: LICENSE is a 2-clause BSD licence (Copyright 1993-2015 Carnegie Mellon University); README: 'Use of this dictionary for any research or commercial purpose is completely unrestricted' and asks for acknowledgement. Keep the copyright, conditions and disclaimer in source and in the app's licenses screen.
components.attribution: The Carnegie Mellon Pronouncing Dictionary, Copyright (C) 1993-2015 Carnegie Mellon University, BSD-style licence (https://github.com/cmusphinx/cmudict).

components.name: WordNet 3.1 English gloss pack (Princeton)
components.reason: Princeton WordNet 3.1 license permits redistribution with copyright and license notice; trademark guidelines apply to the WordNet name.

components.name: Firefox Translations / Bergamot (Mozilla)
components.reason: Bergamot translator and firefox-translations-models are maintained by Mozilla; each model directory states CC-BY or compatible terms on its MODEL_CARD. Lexicon packs in PageNest use separate CC BY-SA sample data until full WASM models are installed.
components.attribution: Translations powered by Bergamot and Firefox Translations (Mozilla). See https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models

components.name: Wiktionary-derived bilingual lexicon sample
components.reason: Compact en↔hi and en↔es lexicon samples shipped as optional downloads; attribution required on the licenses screen.
components.attribution: Sample entries derived from Wiktionary (https://en.wiktionary.org/) under CC BY-SA 4.0.
